preconditions.description: The length of tiles is between 1 and 7.
All characters in tiles are uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of possible non-empty sequences is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({seq for seq in set(permutations(tiles)) if seq})
postconditions.description: The number of possible non-empty sequences is equal to the number of unique permutations of the tiles.
